items.title: Gamers Download Fake Cheats and Hand Attackers a Live Remote Control of Their Windows PCs
items.description: New research uncovered 11 malicious NuGet packages disguised as game cheats, bots, and management panels for popular online titles. The campaign targets gaming communities playing titles such as Albion Online, GTA5RP, GrandRP, Majestic RP, and Throne and Liberty. Once installed, these packages quietly deploy a remote-access payload that captures live screenshots of victims’ machines, exposing…

items.title: New LegacyHive Windows 0-day Vulnerability Allows Users  to Load Another User’s Registry
items.description: A proof-of-concept exploit dubbed LegacyHive has been released, enabling a Windows elevation-of-privilege vulnerability in the Windows User Profile Service that allows a standard user to load another user’s registry hive under their own registry classes root. Registry hives are files that store configuration data for Windows, services, applications, and user profiles. Improperly loading or…

items.title: SonicWall Issues Urgent SMA Patch Warning for Two Zero-Day Exploits
items.description: SonicWall SMA1000 zero-day vulnerabilities CVE-2026-15409 and CVE-2026-15410 can be exploited for remote code execution. The post SonicWall Issues Urgent SMA Patch Warning for Two Zero-Day Exploits appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Microsoft Active Directory Services 0-Day Vulnerability Actively Exploited in the Wild
items.description: Microsoft has released security updates for CVE-2026-56155, an actively exploited elevation-of-privilege vulnerability in Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS). This flaw allows an authenticated local attacker with low privileges to gain administrator-level access on affected systems. items.title: Windows BitLocker 0‑Day Vulnerability Allows Hackers to Bypass Security Feature
items.description: A newly disclosed Windows BitLocker 0‑day vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-50661, exposes encrypted devices to physical attacks that can completely undermine Microsoft’s disk encryption guarantees.
